full_judgment: 39. In reply to this contention the learned Advocate appearing for the acquitted accused Ramizuddin Sarkar and Nur Siddique Sarkar submitted that though prosecution witnesses testified to the passing of order for killing the victim but they did not in their testimony specify exact words uttered by the victim and that none of the witnesses stated this fact to the Investigating Officer PW 9 Md. Shamsul Kabir. PW 1 Amanullah Gazi stated in his evidence that Ramizuddin passed order saying “শালাকে শেষ করে ফেল যত টাকা লাগে আমি দিব” i PW 2 stated in this evidence that accused Ramizuddin passed order saying, “শালাকে শেষ করে ফেল যত টাকা লাগে আমি দিব” PW 3 also referred to the order being passed by Ramizuddin saying, “শালাকে শেষ করে ফেল যত টাকা লাগে আমি দিব” PW 4 Ansar Ali has used the language alleged to have been used by other PWs. But most glaring feature regarding the order alleged to have been passed by Ramizuddin is that none of the prosecution witnesses stated before Investigating Officer regarding the passing of order saying," “শালাকে শেষ করে ফেল যত টাকা লাগে আমি দিব” So it is doubtful if acquitted accused Ramizuddin passed order for killing the victim Rafiq and that the Trial Court also gave benefit of doubt to the accused Ramizuddin. It is a cardinal principle of trial of criminal case that the accused is to be presumed innocent and unless such presumption is rebutted the accused cannot be convicted. In the instant case benefit of doubt has been given by the Trial Court to accused Ramizuddin and that benefit of doubt was given properly on consideration of evidence on record and as such it should not be interfered with.
